about: Probe S2 (C2): the last line at the reception against the provider's line, the line following the incoming ball, the pre-trend within incoming-ball strata, the line's velocity at t, the selection of V1 and the ball extrapolated before t. No outcome of any question: no position after the reception frame enters a figure; only the detection flags of the line in (t, t + W] are read there. The rule is in the docstring of ac2fb.defence.probe_s2.

m10_inventory.source: probe m10 of the plan (tasks/todo.md, inventory of 2026-10-17), printed tables

verdict.rule: C2 dies if the instrument (r >= min_r with the provider's line and the line following the incoming ball) passes in fewer than min_instrument matches, if the pre-trend within stratum (raw or residual) exceeds max_pretrend_sd sd in more than max_over matches, or if any match has fewer than min_v1 receptions with the whole line seen in [t - W, t + W]
